typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule (Industrial/Operations Variation). Do not use Space Grotesk or Inter for headings.

colors.contrast_rules: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Always explicitly set text color on hover. The background must never be fully transparent for overlays, dropdowns, or headers. Use Solid Backgrounds to maintain strict readability in industrial environments.

visual_enhancers.cards: Flat design with maximum 8px border-radius (`rounded-md`). No soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders (`border border-slate-200`) for definition.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in operational/health apps. Use pure solid backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Banned. Keep the UI purely utilitarian and high-contrast.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid. Every pixel must be utilized for data visibility.
grids_and_layouts.responsiveness: Fluidly scale from 390px (mobile) to 1440px (desktop). On mobile, stack items to 1 column. Limit image heights to 80vh max on mobile.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Role-aware sidebar navigation. Admin/Dev routes must be hidden behind role checks. Shared operator shell across all modules.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn/UI for logic. Strip Vercel-look, apply MASCI Operations theme.
components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges (`rounded`), distinct primary action, prominent hit areas.
components.tables: Dense, high-contrast borders, hover rows for scanability. Use Shadcn Table.
components.charts: Recharts via Shadcn Chart components. Accessible color palettes.
components.overlays: Dialogs/Dropdowns MUST have solid backgrounds. Absolute NO transparent drop-downs.

localization.strategy: All visible text strings must be externalized or configured to support English and Spanish seamlessly. Ensure text containers handle variable string lengths without breaking the High-Density Grid layout.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., `transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out`), NOT `transition-all`. Avoid bouncy physics.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: CRITICAL. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="operations-case-submit-button"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA preferred, strictly WCAG AA compliant.

instructions_to_main_agent: Zero Surface Left Behind: Ensure no screen looks like an engineering utility. Hide admin/dev screens.
Replace ALL instances of WP-*, Certification, Canonical, Backend, Frontend with operational terms.
Unify the visual shell. Do not use local styling overrides.
Implement high-density grids for the Operations Cases.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to every button, link, and form input.
Header must have a solid background, no transparent headers.
Follow JS implementation, do not use TS/TSX.
Test components to scale cleanly between 390px and 1440px.
Do not center align `.App` text globally.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Do not center align the app container.
Use modern button styles but avoid overly soft/playful UI. Stick to strict `rounded-md` corners.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create layered design elements with z-index hierarchy but without muddy glassmorphism.
